complexity.notes: The input is guaranteed sorted, so sorting is wasted work and forces an awkward value-to-index remapping; a direct two-pointer scan on nums would be O(n) time and O(1) space. As written, nums2 is an O(n) copy, violating the problem's O(1) extra-space requirement, and mutating nums with pop is poor style. The O(n) index/pop calls are dominated by the sort, so the bound stands.
complexity.summary: Needlessly copies and sorts the already-sorted array (Timsort O(n log n)), then runs an O(n) two-pointer scan on the copy, and finally maps values back to original indices with O(n) list.index calls (plus an O(n) pop to disambiguate duplicates).
